note: Corrections to the Spanish Pokédex entries imported from WikiDex (npm run import-wikidex), for mistakes found when checking them against the English entries and the games' own text. "drop" leaves the entry out (WikiDex has no reliable text for it); "use" takes another game's Spanish entry, for a game whose English entry is the same.

platinum.note: WikiDex's text here is Pearl's (X reuses it in the game data, and X's English is Pearl's); Platinum's own entry isn't on WikiDex

black.note: WikiDex gives Black Platinum's entry, which is really Pearl's (see Platinum)

white.note: WikiDex gives White Platinum's entry, which is really Pearl's (see Platinum)
